title: Kushner Holds Hours-Long Meeting With Netanyahu; Board of Peace Cites 'Path Forward', Vows No Reconstruction Until Disarmament
detail: Jared Kushner held an hours-long meeting with Prime Minister Netanyahu in Israel on August 17, 2026, a day after his talks with Hamas chief Khalil al-Hayya in Egypt, as the US pressed for Israeli sign-off on the 15-point Gaza roadmap Hamas had already accepted. A Board of Peace official described the meeting as 'lengthy, in depth, and very productive,' saying agreement was reached with Netanyahu on a 'path forward,' including plans to organize working groups on Gaza demilitarization and humanitarian needs — while the IDF would continue conducting targeted strikes in the interim. Kushner separately declared: 'We will not allow Gaza to be rebuilt until the demilitarisation occurs,' framing Hamas disarmament as a security gain for Israel and warning that failure to comply would justify intensified Israeli operations. Al Jazeera characterized the talks as failing to produce a breakthrough on implementing the roadmap. Gaza's Health Ministry put the toll since the war began at 73,399 killed and 174,310 wounded, with 1,265 killed since the October 2025 ceasefire.

media.caption: Kushner holds hours-long talks with Netanyahu, says Gaza reconstruction is contingent on Hamas demilitarization

title: Israel Releases 35 Palestinian Prisoners Back Into Gaza
detail: Israel released 35 Palestinian prisoners into Gaza on August 17, 2026, prompting emotional reunions with waiting families. Rights groups say more than 9,400 Palestinians remain in Israeli detention, and have documented allegations of torture, sexual violence, and deliberate starvation in Israeli detention facilities. The release came as US envoy Jared Kushner pressed Israeli and Hamas officials on implementation of the stalled Gaza roadmap.

media.caption: Israel releases 35 Palestinian prisoners back into Gaza; families gather for emotional reunions
